grammar_tips.title: There is / There are
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'there is' for singular and 'there are' for plural things in a place.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'There is' का उपयोग एकवचन के लिए और 'there are' बहुवचन के लिए करें।
